issues.where: Starfield on both sides of the globe and in the lower sky
issues.what: The dust lane matches, but fine stars are subtly displaced to the right relative to the globe and some points are less distinct.
issues.fix: Register the sky separately to the target and preserve the pinpoint star cores when resampling.

issues.where: Upper limb through the upper-right shoulder
issues.what: The rim has a slightly harder, more orange outer line than the target's softer gold-to-black transition.
issues.fix: Reduce the narrow orange fringe and restore the target's smoother atmospheric falloff.

issues.where: Sunlit central cloud bands and upper storm
issues.what: The broad shapes and lighting match, but some fine cloud filaments are slightly softer.
issues.fix: Recover the target's fine-scale cloud contrast without sharpening the whole disc or changing its grade.

issues.where: Lightning clusters in the lower shadowed hemisphere
issues.what: Some flashes are slightly broader and hotter, with a little more spill into the adjacent cloud.
issues.fix: Trim the glow and peak brightness locally so the flashes sit as tightly in the dark cloud as in the target.

issues.where: Sky in tiles B, C, D, E, F, G and H; limb in C; cloud detail in A and lightning in I
issues.what: The hold crops confirm the slight star registration and definition loss, narrow warm upper rim, softer cloud filaments and marginally stronger lightning.
issues.fix: Apply the hold-frame corrections at source, then regenerate the matching crops.

issues.where: Center cloud towers, down-light shadow faces and left foreground ridges
issues.what: Some shadow faces are slightly warmer and more lifted, and a few high-contrast left ridges sit fractionally lower. The ray direction and large cloud geometry still match.
issues.fix: Cool and deepen those shadow faces slightly and tighten local ridge registration without shifting the whole frame.

issues.where: Upper starfield and sun-side horizon immediately below the flare
issues.what: The finest stars are a little softer, and the bright haze slightly flattens the narrow cloud layering under the flare.
issues.fix: Preserve the smallest star cores and recover subtle layer separation under the flare without reducing the sun's overall bloom.

issues.where: Clouds in tiles A, D, E, F and I; sky and horizon in B, C, G and H
issues.what: The terrain crops show the same small cloud-edge drift, warmer shadow faces, reduced fine star definition and slightly flatter flare-side layering.
issues.fix: Correct cloud registration and shadow tone locally, preserve the small stars and match the narrow horizon contrast before recropping.
